questions.question: National Youth Day in India is observed every year on which date?
questions.solution: National Youth Day is observed on 12 January, the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda (born 1863).

questions.tag: Monetary Policy Committee, RBI, Banking news/Oneliner
questions.question: How many members does the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India have?
questions.solution: The MPC has six members: three from the RBI (including the Governor, who chairs it) and three external members appointed by the Government of India.

questions.question: The Ramsar Convention, signed in 1971, is an international treaty for the conservation and wise use of which of the following?
questions.solution: The Ramsar Convention (Ramsar, Iran, 1971) protects wetlands of international importance. World Wetlands Day is observed on 2 February.

questions.passage:
Consider the following statements about the Unified Payments Interface (UPI):

I. UPI was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).
II. UPI allows instant bank-to-bank transfers using a Virtual Payment Address.
III. UPI is regulated by SEBI.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question: STATEMENT BASED QUESTION
questions.solution: UPI was developed by NPCI and enables instant bank-to-bank transfers via a VPA. Statement III is wrong: payment systems are regulated by the RBI, not SEBI.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) located?
questions.solution: The IMF is headquartered in Washington, D.C., USA.

questions.tag: Global Organizations, International news/Match the Column
questions.passage:
Match the organisations in Column I with their headquarters in Column II:

Column I: (a) IMF   (b) WHO   (c) UNESCO   (d) IMO
Column II: (1) Geneva   (2) Paris   (3) London   (4) Washington, D.C.
questions.question: MATCH THE COLUMN
questions.solution: IMF - Washington, D.C.; WHO - Geneva; UNESCO - Paris; IMO - London.

questions.question: Who has been elected as the President of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), serving a one-year term from September 2026?
questions.solution: Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman is the President of the 81st UNGA, succeeding Germany's Annalena Baerbock, who presided over the 80th session.

questions.tag: RBI, Banking news, National news/Statement Based
questions.passage:
Consider the following statements about the RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting of August 2026:

I. The repo rate was kept unchanged at 5.25%.
II. The policy stance was retained as 'Neutral'.
III. Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) is 5.50%

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question: STATEMENT BASED QUESTION
questions.solution: In August 2026 the MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with a Neutral stance, and Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) is 5.00%. Statement III is incorrect.
